remarks: 1 Twilight Place…This is a rare opportunity to own this charming waterfront home with a sandy beach in the sought after Harbor View community. The spectacular sunrises and moonlit evenings over Peach Island and stunning views of Long Island Sound and Norwalk Harbor never stop. Set your watch to the distant hum of the oyster boats heading out for the daily catch every morning. Head out in your kayak, paddleboard, or boat right from your backyard. Delight in the neighborhood activity from your covered front porch, or take advantage of the tennis, playground, ballfield, clubhouse, moorings, dock, swimming, yoga class, book club, and many social events–it’s all part of living in this unique island community. The first floor offers a kitchen, a generous dining room that opens to the living room with a fireplace and sliders to a sunroom steps from the beach and water’s edge. Hold on for the breathtaking primary bedroom with 180-degree water views, hardwood floors, and a walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms with water views and a full bath complete the second level. A third-level bonus room and full bath will certainly delight your guests or be the talked-about entertaining space that opens to the balcony/deck from which one can see for miles. The adjacent space is a cozy playroom, home office, or even finished storage space. Enjoy the proximity to NYC, and SONO’s vibrant shopping and restaurants. Close to train, and highways. Don’t miss this one! SHOWINGS BEGIN 6/3/22
